target_customer: Treasury, finance and sourcing teams at large manufacturers and Fortune 500 companies
problem: Companies cannot easily connect market shifts, tariffs and commodity, currency and rate exposures to specific suppliers, products and margins, so hedging and sourcing decisions are slow.
business_model: B2B software platform, pricing not public
product_category: Supply chain and financial risk software

founders.name: James Simon
founders.background_notes: YC page says his prior work was in commodities trading, which inspired the idea. Employers and education not listed.

competitors.name: Pillar
competitors.what: Financial risk management platform for commodity and currency hedging

competitors.name: DeftHedge
competitors.what: SaaS for currency and commodity risk decisions

competitors.name: Kyriba
competitors.what: Treasury platform adding AI assisted FX hedging

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping external market data to company bills of materials and suppliers is standard data engineering with hard integration work, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with internal ERP data could create switching costs, but a well funded rival raised a large seed in April 2026.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Treasury vendors were adding AI hedging tools in 2025. No Shielded specific response is public.

market_need_then: Tariff changes in 2025 and 2026 and volatile commodity prices raised demand for exposure management, and surveys cited by trade press say 81 percent of corporates hedge FX risk.

branding.domain_note: YC lists shieldedglobal.com, which redirects to shielded.com, suggesting the exact word domain was acquired. No source gives the date or price.

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated companies use Shielded or Shield names, including a privacy firm with a trademark filing, and no press about this brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Shielded joined YC in Summer 2026 and has no exit or public failure. Its site now lists Long Journey, Torch Capital, Y Combinator and Susa Ventures as backers but gives no amounts or dates. The pitch changed between YC's supply chain risk framing and a site focused on currency, commodity and rate hedging, and a competitor raised a large seed in April 2026, so differentiation is the key risk.
notes: The company website listed in the directory redirects to shielded.com; the page there names backers Long Journey, Torch Capital, Y Combinator and Susa Ventures but no rounds, and searches could not confirm Long Journey or Torch Capital. Dealroom shows a $125k seed with no investors visible, one aggregator only, so no round is recorded. The YC page and the site describe different focuses. Only one founder is confirmed.
